messages.subject: Standard Errors
parts:
I humbly prefaced my questions with the idea that these questions reflect my limited working knowledge of R (although to the extent that I have been using R in CFA and IRT contexts, it is a fantastic program).  Is there a reasonably simple, straightforward code to obtain standard errors of b estimates and the discrimination parameter in a graded response model?  Second, the test information function is easily obtained. However, I cannot find how to include the graphic for the measurement error curve.  Any suggestions?


Robert
